name: Centum Reporting Module
description: Generates all 16 CBOM report tabs for one RFQ: CBOM generation, ERP/costing enrichment, HITL conflict resolution, report generation and Excel export

tools.name: centum_reporting__cbom
tools.description: Regenerate only the CBOM table for one rfq_id, from the existing (read-only) input tables. Does not touch the 16 downstream reports.

tools.name: centum_reporting__enrich_erp
tools.description: Fill the _erp columns on the existing CBOM rows for one rfq_id, from erp master data.

tools.name: centum_reporting__enrich_costing_sheet
tools.description: Fill the _costing columns on the existing CBOM rows for one rfq_id, from costing_sheet data.

tools.name: centum_reporting__resolve_final_selection
tools.description: HITL gate: auto-resolve single-source rows; flag multi-source conflicts for human review. Returns hitl=1 when conflicts remain.

tools.name: centum_reporting__generate_reports
tools.description: Regenerate all 16 reports for one rfq_id from existing CBOM data.

tools.name: centum_reporting__validate_reports
tools.description: Run per-tab business-rule validation for all 16 report tables for one rfq_id.

tools.name: centum_reporting__export_reports
tools.description: Export the already-generated CBOM + 16 reports for one rfq_id into a single consolidated Excel workbook.
